articles.headline: Ethereum price nears resistance at $2,530 amid cautious investor sentiment and slowing ETF inflows.
articles.description: Ethereum rallied to $2,667 on September 11 but retraced 11.6% to $2,356 within four days, currently trading near $2,495 and approaching a local resistance at $2,530. Investor caution follows recent rate hikes, which could tighten liquidity and increase market risk. Ethereum ETF outflows of $407.3 million over three days indicate short-term bearish pressure. However, lower transaction costs and recovering network participation suggest potential bullish signs. Traders should watch the $2,380-$2,530 range closely, as a breakout or dip could signal significant moves, emphasizing the need for careful risk management.

articles.headline: Ethereum Foundation warns some tools may fail a...
articles.description: The Ethereum Foundation has issued a warning that the upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade, which changes the gas model, could cause some wallets, indexers, and gas estimators to stop working properly. This alert is important for users and developers relying on these tools to manage transactions and network fees. The foundation advises caution and preparation ahead of the upgrade to avoid disruptions.
